method: Visually authored crown (excluding ponytail), neck base, pelvis and unfolded thigh/shin/foot chain. Source bounds, overall alpha height, arm height, hair length and screen ground projection were not used as scale rulers. Covered/depth-foreshortened limb lengths are checked against another phase of the same sheet.

light1.ruler_description: Crown excludes high ponytail. Follow neck to covered pelvis, then screen-left rear thigh and shin to ankle and sole. Unfolded chain is about 385px; corrected source has genuinely smaller anatomy than all other combat sheets.
light1.variation: No clear within-sheet scale outlier. About 380–390px; do not assign 500px.
light1.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.

light2.ruler_description: Use crown, collar/neck and pelvis under skirt, then long visible rear-leg thigh/shin with sandal sole. Raw visual chain approximately 510px; cross-check frame 6 near 500px. Adopt 500px rounded standing equivalent.
light2.variation: No clear outlier; roughly ±2% among ready and release poses.
light2.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.

light3.ruler_description: Standing support-leg chain in knee-raised frame 2 is approximately 461px before small depth/occlusion allowance, giving ~470px. Frames 1 and 6 require unfolding their wide stance and measure nearer 495–505px. Arms, kick toe extent and ponytail are excluded.
light3.variation: Use per-frame scales here: frames 2–5 have visibly shorter standing-equivalent body chains than broad ready frames 1 and 6, around 6–7% difference. This includes pose/proportion variation, not solely uniform resizing.
light3.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.

air_light.ruler_description: Frame 3 extended screen-right leg provides the least-occluded ruler: crown/neck/pelvis and unfolded thigh-shin-foot is ~514px, with modest depth allowance about 520–525px. For tucked frames 1–2, use full femur/shin lengths cross-checked against frames 3–5 rather than apparent tucked height.
air_light.variation: No clear scale outlier beyond measurement uncertainty. Frame 1 is plausibly ~2% larger. Airborne root is not a ground-height ruler.
air_light.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.

rising.ruler_description: Rising frame 3 crown-to-neck, neck-to-pelvis and visible bent leg chain is ~477px; the upright support leg of frame 4 gives a lower ~450px check. Adopt ~465px. Raised fist, ponytail and jump displacement are excluded.
rising.variation: Frame 4 is somewhat smaller (~450px), frame 3 nearer475px, but variation is within ~5% and uncertainty of hidden hip/leg depth; overrides optional.
rising.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.

dash_strike.ruler_description: Extreme frame 4 follows skull/neck, inclined torso and extended rear thigh/shin to sandal. Raw polyline ~546px; hip/foot-axis allowance gives ~535px. Frames1,2,6 cross-check near490–505px, so 500px is a sensible sheet baseline.
dash_strike.variation: Frame 4 is a clear long-body/leg outlier, ~7% above sheet baseline. Use body_height535 for frame4; others can use500 or listed fine estimates. Head size changes less than leg-chain length, so this is partly exaggerated lunge anatomy rather than uniform scaling.
dash_strike.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.

throw.ruler_description: Hip-turn frame3 yields ~501px from crown/neck/pelvis through front thigh, shin and sole. Forward-folded frame4 is measured by torso-plus-leg chains rather than its crouched silhouette height.
throw.measurement_status: Approximate visual anatomical ruler, rounded for registration; not exact morphometrics.
